objectives: Understand and use the taught kana and inna: different effects patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Kana aur inna dono nominal structure ko affect karte hain lekin aik hi ending rule nahin. كَانَ الطَّالِبُ مُسْتَعِدًّا past state mein subject nominative/predicate accusative; إِنَّ الطَّالِبَ مُسْتَعِدٌ assertion mein noun accusative/predicate nominative hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Kana: اسم kana marfu aur simple adjective khabar mansub. Inna: ism mansub, simple khabar marfu.
أَصْبَحَ / صَارَ state change aur مَا زَالَ continuity de sakte hain; context meaning decide karta hai.
إِنَّ statement ki emphasis aur أَنَّ embedded content mein aata hai: أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الطَّالِبَ مُسْتَعِدٌ.

lessons.title: Present moods with an, lan and lam
objectives: Understand and use the taught present moods with an, lan and lam patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Mudari ke indicative, subjunctive aur jussive ko particle aur verb type ke saath parhen. يَكْتُبُ, لَنْ يَكْتُبَ, لَمْ يَكْتُبْ regular singular example hain. Lam mudari form ke saath past negation deta hai; lan future negation, sirf ending dekh kar tense na chunen.
rulesRomanUrdu: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكْتُبَ: an ke baad shown regular form final fatha.
لَنْ أَكْتُبَ future negative; لَمْ أَكْتُبْ past negative.
لَا أَكْتُبُ ordinary present negative indicative ho sakta hai; prohibitive la ka pattern alag hai.
Weak-final aur afal khamsa ki marking sirf sukoon/fatha nahin; agle lessons mein deletion dekhen.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Afal khamsa paanch mudari patterns hain jo dual, male/mixed plural aur addressed feminine yaa se bante hain. Indicative mein noon retained, subjunctive/jussive mein deleted hoti hai. Feminine plural noon ko is deletion rule se na mitayen.

هُمَا يَكْتُبَانِ se لَمْ يَكْتُبَا; dual alif rehta hai, noon drop.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Weak radicals و ي ا verb ki shakl ko badal sakte hain. قَالَ / يَقُولُ, قُلْتُ aur لَمْ يَقُلْ ka selected set dekhen. Har weak verb ko regular kataba ki endings jor kar nahin bana sakte. Yahan common examples hain, poora weak-verb paradigm nahin.

lessons.title: Passive voice: event and affected subject
objectives: Understand and use the taught passive voice: event and affected subject patterns.
Apply the distinction in an original reading, listening or practical response.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Passive mein doer mention karna zaroori nahin; focus event aur affected cheez par hota hai. كَتَبَ الطَّالِبُ الرِّسَالَةَ se كُتِبَتِ الرِّسَالَةُ. Object nominative نائب الفاعل banta hai. Unknown doer ka naam khud infer na karen.
rulesRomanUrdu: Regular past pattern كَتَبَ se كُتِبَ; feminine message ke saath كُتِبَتْ, next article se connected kasra.
Present active يَكْتُبُ versus passive يُكْتَبُ: prefix damma, penultimate fatha.

Weak/derived verb passive shapes mein extra changes ho sakti hain. Selected examples ko poora pattern samajhne ka substitute na banayen.

objectives: Understand and use the taught active and passive participles patterns.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Participles verb se related nouns/adjectives hain, verb tense ka automatic badal nahin. كَاتِبٌ writer/one writing aur مَكْتُوبٌ written mein role alag hai. Context se occupation, temporary state ya description ka meaning chunein.
rulesRomanUrdu: Regular triliteral active فَاعِلٌ: كَاتِبٌ. Passive مَفْعُولٌ: مَكْتُوبٌ.
Derived active مُعَلِّمٌ teacher aur مُتَعَلِّمٌ learner mein middle vowels/root pattern ko dekhen.

الْعُنْوَانُ مَكْتُوبٌ = address written hai; kis ne aur kab, is phrase se akela establish nahin hota.

Object reference pronoun ko chhorne se taught structure incomplete ho sakta hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Definite masculine الَّذِي, feminine الَّتِي; plural human الَّذِينَ, feminine plural اللَّاتِي ka awareness bhi rakhen.
قَرَأْتُ كِتَابًا أَعْجَبَنِي: indefinite noun ki sentence description mein definite relative insert na karen.
الْمَكْتَبَةُ الَّتِي ذَهَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا: preposition-suffix haa returns to library.
Relative clause ko main predicate se separate karen: الْكِتَابُ الَّذِي قَرَأْتُهُ مُفِيدٌ. Main statement book useful hai.

reading.text: قرأت كتابا أعجبني في المكتبة التي ذهبت إليها أمس. الكتاب الذي قرأته مفيد لأنه يشرح أمثلة قصيرة. الطلاب الذين حضروا اللقاء ناقشوا فصلين فقط، لا الكتاب كله. أما الطالبة التي أرسلت السؤال فلم تحضر، ولذلك أرسلت إليها ملخصا. ينبغي للقارئ أن يتتبع مرجع كل ضمير قبل أن يقرر من حضر ومن أرسل الرسالة.

objectives: Understand and use the taught reason, result and purpose patterns.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Reason action ka sabab, result us ka outcome aur purpose us ka intended goal hai. لِأَنَّ because, لِذٰلِكَ therefore, لِكَيْ so that aur لِـ plus masdar ko context mein alag pehchanen. Purpose ka matlab successful outcome ki guarantee nahin.

كَانَ الْمَكَانُ هَادِئًا؛ لِذٰلِكَ بَقِيتُ: staying result hai.
